profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer at Ventiv Technology
profile.summary: Skilled in PHP, Shopify, HTML, Assembly Language, and Linux. Strong engineering professional with a Bachelor of Science (BS) focused in Electrical Engineering from The University of Texas at Austin.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Developed and maintained the Digital web and mobile applications using the ReactJS and React Native frameworks.
• Integrated Bootstrap 3 throughout the RCA application.
• Developed and maintained unit tests for the RCA application using the Jasmine testing framework.
• Integrated third party libraries such as Google Maps APIs in the RCA application.
• Executed performance analysis and debugging through Chrome Developer Tools.
• Performed investigative and proof-of-concept tasks for migration to new technologies.

 Accomplishments:
• Instrumental in refactoring the RCA application based on accepted AngularJS style guides.
• Gained valuable experience using Karma and Jasmine to unit test the RCA application
• Gained extensive knowledge and experience using the AngularJS framework.
• Gained extensive knowledge and experience using the ReactJS and React Native frameworks.
• Gained valuable experience deploying iOS and Android versions of the Digital mobile application.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Worked with a team of developers to design and implement a responsive and mobile-friendly map-centric web application for tracking merchants and the offers they provide for their customers which are viewed by customers on an iOS or Android app
• Employed a microservice architecture along with technologies like React, Mapbox, GraphQL, Apollo, and AWS DynamoDB to deliver a decoupled application that allowed for concurrent work on multiple components and flexibility to plug in specific components to meet customer needs as well as restrict access to certain components based on user roles.

positions.title: Software Engineer Intern
positions.description:
• Designed and implemented an ASP.NET MVC 4 web application that parses raw XML files
containing manager assignments for various products and presents the data in a human-readable
and interactive format
• Utilized modern web development tools like jQuery, AngularJS, and Bootstrap to produce a
efficient, intuitive, and responsive web application that can be used by employees in multiple departments

positions.title: Engineering Intern
positions.description:
• Created an automated system using Visual Basic to compile raw data from contact lens machines
into control charts for effective productivity analysis
• Designed and implemented a content management system using PHP/SQL that manages open
project milestones and shift report data and graphs
• Participated in engineering studies that investigated and improved issues such as seal leaks and
mold imperfections.

positions.title: Software Development Intern
positions.description:
• Performed maintenance on existing hospital scheduling software to fit client needs
• Worked on a team of interns to develop a credentialing system for use by doctors to keep track of certifications
• Communicated directly with clients and ensured a user-friendly interface for all products developed
• Managed a team of four interns that developed a web application to track hospital volunteer hours.

positions.title: Unit Leader and Counselor-In-Training Program Director
positions.description:
• Supervised 24 children per session in a summer camp environment and ensured their safety and well-being
• Managed three other staff members per session and evaluated their job performance regularly to ensure efficiency and safety in the unit.

positions.title: Assistant Equestrian Instructor
positions.description:
• Assisted with management of the barn
• Helped oversee up to ten underage staff members per session
• Assisted mounted lessons in the arena and taught girls how to ride horses
• Instructed young Girl Scouts in ground lessons and taught them how to work with horses safely.

positions.title: Cashier/Hostess
positions.description:
• Developed customer service skills by helping guests pay bills, seating guests at empty tables, and serving customers at the counter
• Worked with a team of employees to give customers an enjoyable dining experience
• Solved problems in the restaurant and assisted difficult customers.
